The only brief luminous effect allowed is a compact cyan muzzle flash AT THE CUTTER'S REAL PRONGS when a row explicitly requests a shot. No beam drawn to an absent target. CRITICAL: TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA with alpha0 background, NO brown glow/gradient/backdrop/floor/text/labels/grid/panels/shadow. Draw SMALL full bodies with huge20pxtransparent margins per cell. Do not add fifthfigure or omitrow. Rightward facing.

ROW1 uprightCalibration: four distinct fully UPRIGHT neutral calibration bodies,handslowered,toolsecuredathip. Calibration only, not deliveredstate.

ROW3 crouchIdle: four genuine LOW BALANCED CROUCHED idle bodies, subtle differing glove/weight/head configurations, equipment safelysecured, no standingup. Keepnaturallyshorterprojection.
ROW4 reservedUprightStudy: four different fully UPRIGHT calibration/tool-safety poses,handslow. Reserved, not deliveredstate.
